title: Psychology Facts
hook: Would you deny what your own eyes see?
facts: In 1951, Solomon Asch showed people *three lines* and one simple question.
Everyone else in the room was secretly an *actor* giving wrong answers.
Alone, people almost never erred. Under *1%* of answers were wrong.
But with the actors, about *3 in 4* people went along at least once.
outro: Sometimes, you'd deny your own eyes.
